projects.name: SAP EWM Implementation & Support
details: • Participated in end-to-end SAP Extended Warehouse Management (EWM) implementations,
supporting solution design, configuration, testing, and deployment.
• Conducted unit testing and UAT; ensured solutions met user expectations and business
needs.
• Configured warehouse processes and integrated EWM with MM, SD modules.
• Developed functional specs, SOPs, and executed master data and bin upload activities.
• Worked on CIF functionality for master data transfer.
• Provided issue diagnosis and resolution, performing root cause analysis for functional and
integration issues, particularly with SAP ECC.
• Contributed to solution improvement initiatives by analyzing existing processes and
proposing enhancements to improve warehouse efficiency and accuracy.
• Demonstrated strong analytical thinking, problem-solving skills.
• Monitored queues and scheduled background jobs for process automation.

projects.name: Job Work Process Implementation
details: • Configured warehouse structure such as warehouse number storage types, storage bins to facilitate efficient warehouse operations and ensure accurate material storage and retrieval.
• Debugged and optimized custom objects for performance and reliability.
• Integrated dashboards for real-time tracking of vehicle movement and warehouse KPIs.
• Provided timely support and resolutions to incidents within SLA guidelines.
Anuje Industries, Kolhapur
